threads.body: [General] This guard skips `messaging.client.operation.duration` for `ReceiveMessage` failures that occur before `beforeTransmission` (for example, credential or signing failures), because `SDK_HTTP_REQUEST_ATTRIBUTE` is only populated there. That contradicts the stated failed-receive behavior and differs from the v1.11 path, which invokes SQS failure handling for every initialized receive request. Please make the receive/HTTP attribute extraction tolerate a missing HTTP request and invoke this handling whenever the request timer is present.
